dataset.name: UCI Cardiotocography
dataset.citation: Ayres-de-Campos D, Bernardes J, Garrido A, Marques-de-Sa J, Pereira-Leite L. (2000). SisPorto 2.0: A program for automated analysis of cardiotocograms. Journal of Maternal-Fetal Medicine 9:311-318.
dataset.target: NSP: 1 normal, 2 suspect, 3 pathologic; CLASS excluded
dataset.cohort: All 2126 records, all 21 standard measurements; no subsampling, feature selection or missing-value exclusions

split.type: 80/20 stratified by NSP; within-class test size rounded; shuffled training classes dealt round-robin to three sites
split.seed_scope: R train/test/site split and central initialization only; node DP randomness is not researcher-seeded

bounds_policy: Same campaign rule: public TRAIN cohort min/max widened by 10 percent of each range, plus/minus 0.5 for constants. Declared before training, never derived from test. This public-data utility simulation does not claim that private empirical extrema can be freely disclosed.

training.parameters: All pytorch_multiclass v0.5.0 registry defaults: linear softmax, 3 classes, SGD, learning_rate 0.1, batch_size 32, local_epochs 1, no scheduler, no regularization
training.privacy: Unchanged node defaults except administrator per-training epsilon; delta 1e-6, row unit, clipping norm 1, replace-one adjacency
training.inner_validation: None; no schedule selection or hyperparameter search

central: nnet::multinom, decay=0, maxit=3000, reltol=1e-10, MaxNWts=10000. Same clipped affine bounds transform as federated model; fit pooled training data; require convergence=0.
trivial: Training majority class for accuracy; training class proportions for probability metrics, yielding tied-score macro-AUC 0.5. No test prevalence used.
metrics: Unweighted mean of three one-vs-rest rank AUCs with average ties; argmax accuracy; natural-log multiclass log-loss with true-class probability floor 1e-15. Gap is federated minus central macro-AUC. SD is sample SD over three paired seeds.
diagnostic: At epsilon 8, mean accuracy strictly above mean majority accuracy AND mean macro-AUC > 0.5. Also disclose each replicate and whether all pass.
test_use: One scoring pass per replicate, after settings are fixed; no rerun of a scored cell with changed settings.
alternative: None: full specified cohort is used and no fallback multiclass contract is named. Report a failing diagnostic as a boundary.
